crossRefs.note: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand…
May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.
David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”
David said to him, “Your blood be on your head; for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain…

translations.web: Yahweh forbid that I should stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head, and the jar of water, and let’s go.”
translations.bsb: But the LORD forbid that I should extend my hand against the LORD’s anointed. Instead, take the spear and water jug by his head, and let us go.”
translations.kjv: The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD'S anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.
translations.asv: Jehovah forbid that I should put forth my hand against Jehovah's anointed: but now take, I pray thee, the spear that is at his head, and the cruse of water, and let us go.
